legal_units.title: Modification and revision of notice in certain cases.
legal_units.text: Where,— the Assessing Officer shall serve on the assessee a modified notice of demand specifying the sum payable, if any, and such notice shall be treated as a notice under section 289 and the provisions of this Act shall accordingly apply in relation to such notice.

legal_units.title: Modification and revision of notice in certain cases.
legal_units.text: The modified notice of demand as referred to in sub-section (1) shall be revised where the order referred to in sub-section (1)(b) is modified by the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal or the Supreme Court.
